title: Idempotency-Key on POST /invoices
prompt: Clients retry POST /invoices after timeouts and end up with duplicate invoices. Support an optional `Idempotency-Key` request header: the first request with a given key creates the invoice and remembers the key with the invoice id; a repeat with the same key returns the same invoice (status 200 instead of 201) without creating another; the same key with a different body returns 409 with `{ error: { message } }`. An in-memory store injected through the router's dependencies is enough; no persistence. Keep the key store as its own small module and unit test the three behaviours through the router.
